title: RNGdle - Daily Random Number Game with Badges & EP
description: Play RNGdle online. Roll one daily random number, collect pattern badges, score EP, and share rare results from digits, primes, palindromes, and lucky numbers.
twitterDescription: Play RNGdle, roll today's number, and see which badges and EP it unlocks.
schemaDescription: RNGdle is a free browser game where one daily random number is analyzed for badges, rarity, and EP.

seoSections.title: What is RNGdle?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: RNGdle is a daily random number game inspired by the thrill of one clean roll. Each day, the player generates a number from 0 to 1,000,000 and RNGdle scans it for patterns such as primes, palindromes, repeated digits, lucky sevens, clean endings, and special number references.

The fun comes from turning pure randomness into a scorecard. A plain number can still earn common badges, while rare RNGdle moments such as exact special numbers, long repeated runs, or unusual mathematical properties can produce huge EP swings.

seoSections.title: How does RNGdle scoring work?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: Every matched badge has an EP value. Common badges such as Even, Odd, Pair, or Six Digits add small amounts, while rare badges such as Jackpot, Leet, Exact Nice, or six repeated sevens are worth dramatically more.

Some RNGdle badges belong to the same family. In those cases, only the strongest badge in that family contributes EP, while the rest still appear as supporting discoveries. This keeps one lucky pattern from double-counting too aggressively.

seoSections.title: How do you play RNGdle?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: Open RNGdle, roll once, and watch the result break into badges, rarity notes, and EP. The game is quick by design, so the daily challenge feels more like checking a curious number than grinding a long session.
After the result appears, RNGdle gives you a shareable summary with the rolled number and the most interesting badges it unlocked.

seoSections.title: What RNGdle badges can you get?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: RNGdle badges cover both math patterns and number-culture references. A roll may unlock badges for primes, palindromes, repeated digits, clean endings, lucky sevens, six-digit numbers, or exact values such as 69, 420, and 1337.
Badge families keep scoring readable. If several related RNGdle badges match the same number, the result can show the supporting discoveries while scoring only the strongest badge in that family.

seoSections.title: Is RNGdle a daily game?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: Yes. This static version stores one roll per UTC day in the browser using localStorage. The next roll becomes available after the UTC midnight countdown reaches zero.
Accounts are available for signing in across visits, while roll history, lifetime EP, and the daily lock still live on the current device.

seoSections.title: What features are local in this RNGdle version?
seoSections.subtitle: Unused
paragraphs: The core gameplay loop is reproduced: generate a daily number, reveal badges, calculate EP, estimate rarity, and share the result.
This version includes authenticated profiles, but global leaderboards, hearts, friend feeds, and server-issued claim tokens are still represented as local-only behavior here.
